purpose: Teach: コマース/押し出し/平米/弐/作製/一任/隔週/通りかかっ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: Eコマース対応のチームを増員しましょう
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Matter-of-fact delivery, no hedging. Steady pace. She's setting the agenda and expecting alignment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プレゼンでの押し出しを強くする練習をしましょう
lines.en: Yes. Let's practice making the pitch more forceful in the presentation.
lines.style: Agreeable but attentive. Quick nod in the voice. Earnest — he's already thinking about execution, not just compliance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新オフィスの平米数を比較しましょう
lines.en: Let's compare the square footage of the new office.
lines.style: Tactical, moving forward. Brief, directive. No warmth needed here — it's procedural and she expects it to land cleanly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類に「弐千円」と書く時はご注意ください
lines.en: Yes. Just be careful when you write '2,000 yen' on the documents.
lines.style: Helpful aside, almost parenthetical. Light concern underneath — not alarmist, just flagging something he might miss. Conversational tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 限定パンフレットを作製しましょう
lines.en: Let's create a limited edition pamphlet.
lines.style: Another directive, same tempo as before. She's moving through the checklist with confidence. Clear ownership of the decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今回はベテラン担当者に一任します
lines.en: Yes. This time I'm going to leave it entirely to the senior staff member.
lines.style: Confident delegation. Slight lift on 'entirely' — he's made a judgment call and stands by it. Trusting his own read of the situation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 隔週で進捗報告会をしましょう
lines.en: Let's have progress check-in meetings every two weeks.
lines.style: Back to agenda mode. Setting cadence. Clear, no room for ambiguity. This is the final structural piece she needs in place.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様が通りかかったので、お声がけしました
lines.en: Yes. A regular customer happened to walk by, so I greeted them.
lines.style: Light, almost conversational wind-down. A small moment of real interaction breaking through the procedural list. Warm, but still professional.
